caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object is a small figurine shaped like a bird, possibly a dove, perched on a rounded, decorative pedestal. The bird is predominantly brown with a darker, patterned texture on its back and wings, a lighter brown head and chest, and a small black beak. A thin red line is visible along the lower part of the bird’s wing. The pedestal beneath the bird is a light brown, stone-like color with subtle greenish hues and features ornamental ridges, bands, and rows of small raised dots as decoration. The drawing includes the artist’s signature, "Frank McEntee," in small, neat letters towards the bottom right corner. The composition is simple, with the figurine positioned centrally and ample negative space surrounding it.
title: Pa. German Chalkware Chicken
